q1.question: What is SweetWine?
q1.answer: SweetWine is a platform for conversations with AI characters - your AI Girlfriend, AI Boyfriend, AI Friend, or AI Anime character. Chat, generate images and videos, and enjoy personalized interactions. It is like having your own digital character who always listens, understands you, and adapts to your style over time.

q2.answer: Yes, SweetWine is a legitimate service with your privacy as our top priority. We comply with GDPR and other data protection standards, and handle your data with care. q1.question: How can an AI help with breakup recovery?
q1.answer: Our AI character provides a safe space to process your emotions without judgment. You can vent, analyze what happened, work through feelings of loss, and receive empathetic responses 24/7. It's like having a supportive friend available whenever you need to talk.

q2.question: Is this a replacement for therapy?
q2.answer: No, our AI character is not a licensed therapist and doesn't replace professional mental health care. It's a supportive tool for everyday emotional processing. If you're experiencing severe depression or crisis, please seek professional help.

q3.question: Can I talk about my ex as much as I need?
q3.answer: Absolutely. Unlike friends who might get tired of hearing about your breakup, your AI character has infinite patience. Talk about your ex, analyze the relationship, process your feelings - as many times as you need without any judgment.

q4.question: Will the AI remember my story?
q4.answer: Yes, your AI character remembers your conversations and the details of your situation. You don't have to re-explain everything each time. It provides continuity in your healing journey.

q5.question: Is my conversation kept private?
q5.answer: Completely private. All conversations are encrypted and never shared. We understand that breakup conversations are deeply personal, and your privacy is absolutely protected.
